note: Set A is significantly better because it correctly identifies the layer composition at the Trailing Edge (TE) and Leading Edge (LE) regions, whereas Set B repeatedly claims 'medium_density_foam' exists at the TE and 'glass_uni' exists at the LE, which contradicts the charts (foam is central, glass_uni is at the tips). Both sets share errors regarding CarbonUD location at LE and confusing total stack thickness with CarbonUD layer thickness, but Set B has a much higher volume of fundamental misreadings of the chart layout.
